traces for productcatalogservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.01->0.01ms (1.17x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 2.42->202.98ms (84.05x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency-50 deviation (z=567.93) is smaller than productcatalogservice latency-90 (z=955.44) (E1), and callers see the added time on productcatalogservice calls (E2), so frontend is inheriting the latency.
Its latency-90 deviation (z=462.83) is about half of productcatalogservice's (E1), and the inbound delay sits on productcatalogservice spans (E2), so it is a downstream victim.

Own-span self-time is unchanged (0.01->0.01ms, 1.17x) while inbound calls went from 2.42 to 202.98ms (E2). CPU saturation would slow its own processing, but this is roughly 200ms of added network-level delay.

proposed_fix.description: Remove the injected network delay on productcatalogservice, for example by clearing the tc netem qdisc or chaos rule on its pod or interface. Then confirm that caller-observed p50 latency returns to about 2ms, rolling the pod if needed.
